newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav customs seizes heroin on Bulgaria border.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav customs seizes heroin on Bulgaria border.

text.p: BELGRADE, Feb 7 (Tanjug) - Yugoslav customs seized just over five kg (11 lbs) of heroin on the Yugoslav-Bulgarian border, state news agency Tanjug reported on Friday.

Quoting the Federal Customs Administration office, Tanjug said the drugs were found in false compartments of two travel bags allegedly belonging to a Polish man on the Istanbul-Budapest train on Thursday.
In mid-October, Yugoslav officials seized 190 kg (480 lbs) of heroin and just two weeks later another 373 kg (820 lbs) on the same border. Both hauls were concealed in trucks.
